asks.title: Training Table Trivia
asks.summary: Quiz a teammate on food, fuel, and team traditions while you eat. Short, fun, and easy to film at the dining hall.
steps: Ask at least three questions on camera

asks.title: Podcast Guest Submission
asks.summary: Tell us a story from your season in your own words. We pick guests for the next round of episodes from these.
steps: Record a two minute voice or video pitch
Say your name, school, and sport first
Share the file link when you submit

asks.title: Game Day Get Ready With Me
asks.summary: Take us from your room to warmups on a home game day.
steps: Show the routine, the fit, and the walk in
Post as a collab with your campus channel

asks.title: Day in the Life
asks.summary: Class, practice, meals, and everything in between. One full day, start to finish.
steps: Film vertical, one to three minutes
Add a voice over so we hear it from you

asks.title: What I Eat in a Day
asks.summary: Show what fuels a training day, from breakfast to the late snack.
steps: Name each meal on screen or in the voice over

asks.title: Senior Season Spotlight
asks.summary: One senior per campus channel sits down for a short interview about their last season.
steps: We send the questions after you claim it
Film horizontal in a quiet spot with good light
